title: Nucleofection and adoptive transfer of primary mouse T lymphocytes
protocol: Excise spleens from 8-12 week old mice using fine forceps and scissors.
Place the spleen into a 40 μm pore size nylon cell strainer on top of a 50 ml Falcon tube.
Crush the spleen with a plunger from a 3 ml syringe to force tissue through the cell strainer.
Rinse the plunger and cell strainer with 10 ml PBS-0.5% BSA into the tube.
Transfer the whole cell suspension into a 15 ml Falcon tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 x g for 10 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 10 ml PBA-BSA.
Count the cells and centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 x g for 10 min.
Pipette off the supernatant completely.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 40 μl of buffer per 10^7 total cells.
Add 10 μl of Biotin-antibody cocktail per 10^7 total cells.
Mix well and incubate for 10 min at 4°C to 8°C.
Add 30 μl of buffer and 20 μl of anti-Biotin MicroBeads per 10^7 total cells.
Mix well and incubate for an additional 15 min at 4°C to 8°C.
Wash cells with buffer by adding 10 times the labeling volume and centrifuge at 300 x g for 10 min.
Pipette off supernatant completely.
Resuspend cell pellet in 500 μl of buffer per 10^8 total cells.
Place a LS column in the magnetic field of MidiMACS™ separator.
Prepare the column by rinsing with 3 ml of buffer.
Apply cell suspension onto the column. Allow the cells to pass through and collect effluent as fraction with unlabeled cells, representing the enriched CD4 positive T cell fraction.
Wash column with 3 x 3 ml of buffer and collect the entire effluent in the same tube as effluent of step 11.
Count the cells and centrifuge the cells at 300 x g for 10 min. The cells are now ready for nucleofection.
Pre-warm the supplemented Nucleofector solution to room temperature.
Prepare 12-well plates by filling 1.5 ml fully supplemented Mouse T Cell Nucleofector Medium per well and pre-equilibrate plates in a humidified 37°C-5% CO₂ incubator for at least 30 min.
Count the isolated CD4 positive T cells in PBA-0.5% BSA.
Resuspend the cell pellet in room temperature supplemented Nucleofector Solution to a final concentration of 3 x 10^6 purified CD4 positive T cells per 100 μl.
Add 3 μg Smad3 shRNA or Luciferase shRNA.
Transfer the sample into an Amaxa cuvette within 15 minutes to maintain cell viability and gene transfer efficiency.
Avoid air bubbles while pipetting.
Close the cuvette with a blue cap.
Select X–01 Nucleofector program.
Insert the cuvette into the cuvette holder and press the "X" button to start the program.
Remove the samples from the cuvette immediately after the program displays "OK".
Add approximately 500 μl of pre-equilibrated, fully supplemented Mouse T Cell Nucleofector Medium to the cell suspension in the cuvette.
Transfer the sample from the cuvette using a plastic pipette and place it into a prepared 12-well plate.
Press the "X" button to reset the Nucleofector.
Incubate cells in a humidified 37°C–5% CO₂ incubator for 3 hours.
Collect the cells after 3 hours of culture, count them, and transfer them intravenously into syngeneic recipients at a dose of 3 x 10⁶ cells/mouse using a 281/2 gauge needle.
Immunize mice subcutaneously with OVA₃₂₃₋₃₃₉ peptide emulsified in IFA three hours after the adoptive transfer of T cells.
Immunize mice subcutaneously with OVA323-339 peptide emulsified in IFA.
Administer anti-CD40L at 250 μg/mouse.
Administer CTLA4-Ig fusion protein at 250 μg/mouse.
Isolate lymphocytes from spleens five days after immunization.
Perform FACS analysis to determine transfection efficiency.
Determine in vivo expansion of TCR transgenic (KJ1-26+) T cells.
